advisories.title: @better-auth/oauth-provider may provide access tokens for unauthorized audiences via unbound resource indicators
advisories.rationale: The stable Better Auth 1.6.x line has no patched release, and PGID does not enable general-purpose RFC 8707 resource indicators.
compensatingControls: PGID configures exactly one valid audience and every resource server requires that exact audience.
The Worker rejects every resource parameter at both /oauth2/authorize and /oauth2/token.
Better Auth core and plugins remain exact-pinned on the same stable patch line and are upgraded together.
